name: RoadCode
definition: RoadCode is the end-to-end coding, building, debugging, hosting, deployment, and technical guidance product. It is not just a code editor. It is the product that answers: 'Okay, the code exists — now what?' It should help the user understand what a project needs next: domain, database, backend, frontend, environment variables, Cloudflare, Vercel, Railway, local server, Pi, SSH, Git, tests, logs, deployment, rollback, and ongoing maintenance. RoadCode should fix the GitHub traffic-jam problem by routing work through the 172-step process, the 17,290 master index, the 1,729 capability layer, and the 27 agents.
boundary: From idea to running system without the 'now what?' cliff.
mvp: Inspect repo, plan patch, route to correct agent, explain deployment.
core_promise: From idea to running system, without the 'now what?' cliff.
